Meta.title: Kirayla — rent things by the day in Baku, Ganja and Sumgait
Meta.description: Cameras, drills, tents, bikes, consoles and dresses — rent from your neighbours by the day, or list your own things and earn.
Meta.ogAlt: Kirayla — rent and lend everyday things by the day

Nav.banner: Rent out your own things — listing is free

Home.tagline: Don't buy it, rent it. Your neighbour's camera, drill, tent and more — by the day.
Home.how1: Browse a category or search, and see free days on the calendar.
Home.how2: Pick your dates and send the host a short note. The booking is on once they accept.
Home.how3: Pick it up, get the job done, bring it back on time — get your deposit back and leave a review.
Home.hostTitle: What sits in your cupboard can earn
Home.hostText: A camera, a tent, a tool or a dress — list it in minutes, approve requests yourself and track earnings in your dashboard.
